items.title: Drivers to save up to £300 when installing EV chargers at home, as government slashes unnecessary red tape
items.summary: From today, people no longer need planning permission to install cross-pavement EV chargers.

items.title: Publication of the DVLA business plan 2026 to 2027
items.summary: Announcing publication of the Driver and Vehicle Licensing Agency (DVLA) 2026 to 2027 business plan.

items.title: Traffic Commissioners for Great Britain publish 2025-26 annual report
items.summary: The Traffic Commissioners for Great Britain have today (30th September 2026) released their Annual Report to the Secretary of State for 2025 to 2026.

items.title: School minibus operator suspended and fleet cut after serious compliance failings
items.summary: A North East independent school has had its public service vehicle operator’s licence suspended and curtailed following a public inquiry which identified significant maintenance and compliance shortcomings.

items.title: Chiltern Railways brought into public ownership
items.summary: Chiltern Railways brought into public ownership with more daily services and more reliable journeys.

items.title: Great British Railways sets course for rail freight growth
items.summary: Government sets a new rail freight target to help businesses move more goods by rail, strengthen supply chains and support economic growth.

items.title: Crackdown on illegal number plates with new government funded roads policing team
items.summary: New roads policing centre helping to track down offenders faster and disrupt organised crime groups that rely on England's road network.

items.title: Free bus travel 24/7 for disabled people as Prime Minister takes further action to ease cost of living
items.summary: Eligible disabled people across England will get free bus travel all day, every day, after the Prime Minister announced today (Tuesday 18 August) that the government will lift time restrictions on concessionary passes.

items.title: Review launched to shape pathway to reach zero emission driving by 2035
items.summary: Submit your views on the ZEV Mandate review consultation by 23 October 2026.

items.title: Two new non-executive directors appointed to the DVSA board
items.summary: Heidi Alexander, Secretary of State for Transport, has appointed 2 new non-executive directors to the Driver and Vehicle Standards Agency (DVSA) board.

items.title: Furniture firm’s operator licence application refused over “classic Phoenix Syndrome” concerns
items.summary: A North West furniture manufacturer has been refused an HGV operator’s licence after a Traffic Commissioner found that the company’s sole director had been involved in a repeated pattern of business failures, substantial unp…

items.title: Recycling operator’s fleet halved after widespread tachograph and driver management failures
items.summary: A West Midlands recycling operator has had its HGV fleet authorisation cut by 50% after a Traffic Commissioner found serious failings in driver management, tachograph compliance and operational oversight.

items.title: Over £7 million to fuel zero-emission flight across the UK
items.summary: Announces £7.3 million in funding for 8 projects aiming to fuel the UK's transition to zero-emission flights.

items.title: New stations, faster journeys and better connections as works begin to restore Portishead line for the first time in 60 years
items.summary: With services due to begin in 2028, passengers will be able to travel directly between Portishead and Bristol Temple Meads in around 25 minutes.

items.title: Operation cracks down on waste crime in Cumbria
items.summary: The Environment Agency has led a major multi-agency operation to tackle waste crime in Cumbria.

items.title: Transport Secretary engages with EU commissioner on EES border checks ahead of summer holidays
items.summary: Government is working with the EU to ensure travel across the border is as seamless as possible in summer and through autumn.

items.title: Government backs Brighton beaches with new funding
items.summary: The £22 million government investment will replace dozens of Victorian arches to avoid the risk of collapse and ensure the road is safe for the next 100 years.
